lifecycle_gaps_retained: Exact legal date on which the 1935 U.S.-Canada trade agreement terminated (the order's cease clause) is not shown by a held text; the NO rests on the fixed quota period, which ended on June 30, 1939.
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I read the complete held EO 8051 (4 FR 959, Feb. 15, 1939, 'Limiting the Importation of Red Cedar Shingles From Canada During the First Six Months of 1939'). Its recitals set out section 811 of the Revenue Act of 1936 (a new order each half-calendar year while the 1935 U.S.-Canada trade agreement operates), the prior orders 7575, 7701, 7822 and 7946 for earlier half-years, and Article XVIII of the Nov. 17, 1938 agreement. The single operative sentence orders 'that the quantity of red cedar shingles imported from Canada which may be admitted to entry during the first six months of the calendar year 1939 shall be limited to 1,051,168 squares', and adds 'Upon the termination in whole of the trade agreement entered into with Canada under date of November 15, 1935, in accordance with the provisions of Article XVIII of the trade agreement with Canada signed on November 17, 1938, this Executive Order shall cease to have force and effect.' The TERM record I cite carries that cease-to-have-effect clause. The ending I rely on is the order's own fixed period: the only command is a quota on entries during Jan. 1-June 30, 1939, so the order has nothing left to operate on after June 30, 1939, and section 811 makes each half-year a separate new order, not an extension of this one. The cease clause is a second, earlier-or-equal own-term; I did not need to date the termination of the 1935 agreement, and I record that gap openly. D6 self-check: the history holds only 'See' cross-references to EO 7701, 7822 and 7946 (earlier half-year quota orders); a corpus search for the order number and for 'red cedar shingles' finds only EO 7575, 7701, 7822, 7946, 7947 (all earlier or unrelated) and EO 8051 itself, no EO 8051 amendment, extension or revival. No savings clause appears in the text. Provisional NO hypothesis only.
